design_summary: A stationary housing (BOD-0012) with a rectangular internal channel along X and two side guide rails. A drawer (BOD-0013) slides along the channel, with guide grooves on its sides that engage with the rails for controlled motion. The drawer has a front face for grasping, an internal storage volume, and a rear stop face. The housing has an aperture at the front for drawer access and stop lugs at front and rear to limit travel. The open and closed states are clearly defined, with the drawer sliding along the rails.
